name: Silahdars
headerMeta: Golden era · Melee Infantry · special · 300 leadership · Seasonal
pitch: A skill-dependent curve-sword bruiser that explodes through careful ability timing and team support, excelling in blob and sustained fights but utterly neutered by burst or interruption.

doctrines.name: Epic Combat Doctrine
doctrines.effect: After every 3 attacks: next attack's DMG +11%. Every 6 attacks: restores 15% max HP. Every 9 attacks: 2.5s CC immunity.

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Maximum Decapitate damage; favors full burst playstyle. {2}

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: +11 points bottom, rest top — more versatile across sustained and mixed fights; daze immunity overlaps with CC-immunity passive, so the 20% damage boost on Death Strike and Cover Commander is the payoff. {2}

veterancy.label: Mixed allocation
veterancy.body: Sacrifice cooldown and some Decapitate damage to get 20% more on Death Strike and Cover Commander — smart if your playstyle leans heavy on Cover Commander duration. {2}

battleRole.positioning: Find heavy infantry anchors (Fortebraccio, Palace Guards, Grayhairs) and follow their engage — you are a support burst, not a primary frontline. {2} Stay in CC immunity downtime by staggering your three skills; never lead the fight yourself. {1}
battleRole.tips: Spells last 6s with 40% damage reduction for 3s after — rotate them so you always have one active and skip downtime gaps. {1} Sideways Sweep and Deathstrike both last 6s; do not cancel them early. {1} Imperial Fervor (damage reduction) only works during the attack animation, not just on activation. {1} Against shields, Deathstrike breaks block instantly; Decapitate does not. {2} Use Deathstrike after Cover Commander for consistency — timing it raw can miss. {2} If enemy's Deathstrike is on cooldown, the matchup is much safer. {3}

numbers.label: Sideways Sweep & Deathstrike damage boost
numbers.value: +30% since the 8/15/2024 patch, includes Deathstrike released under Get Over Here

cards.name: Varangian Guards
cards.why: Silahdars' Deathstrike shreds them if off cooldown; safer when it's timed out

cards.name: Spartan meta / high-DR units
cards.why: Better in blob and sustained fights vs tanky/defensive comps

matchups.pressure: Worse against Reapers, 1v1s, and instant-burst matchups (Claymores, cavalry). {1}

controls.notes: X-move close → press 1 (Sideways Sweep) → at 11s left on 1's CD press 2 (Deathstrike) → at 24s left on 2's CD press 3 (Get Over Here) → press 1 again → repeat 3 on cooldown. {1} Both 1 and 2 last 6s — never cancel them early. {1} 1 and 2 both reduce damage taken 40% for 3s and remove control effects instantly, increasing attack rate for their full duration. {1} 3 (Get Over Here / Cover Commander): when away deals more damage + knocks down; when reached, damage drops, no knockdown. {2} Never use Cover Commander if you can disengage and wait cooldowns instead. {1} Decapitate (1) is your main damage tool — against shields, Deathstrike (2) breaks block but deals less damage and risks no-damage-reduction window if you weave basic attacks. {2} Deathstrike against charging enemies deals extra damage. {1}

gaps: Exact veterancy point allocation by ability (top-line damage tree, bottom-line defense tree, mixed) lacks a labeled icon-to-slot mapping; allocation pattern (+11 bottom, rest top) confirmed but granular breakdown unconfirmed.
No house guide or dedicated strategy doc exists; guidance frozen at 2022–2024 video era, pre-date to current patch meta.
Skill-2 and Skill-3 names vary by source: Amya uses 'Deathstrike' and 'Get Over Here'; SuperKitowiec uses 'Death Strike' and 'Cover Commander' — latter is the ui-labeled name per unit mechanics.
